HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
